_comment: Gold-corpus accuracy gate. Expected values were pinned 2026-07-02 from the production pipeline on the WSL essentia_tf and native Windows engines (identical genre/subgenre/BPM/key/energy/mood/vocal, confidences within 0.01), and verified the same day on the ONNX engine on real ubuntu + macos runners (native-smoke run 28592194670, full tier: 'gold-corpus gate (onnx): 3 reference clips reproduced their pinned genre/BPM/key') — so all three engine/OS combinations the CI gates run are confirmed against these pins. The gate asserts these so a result regression (not just a crash) fails CI. Tolerances: bpm/energy 'close' absorb decode/rounding jitter; genre/key are exact. gold_house has NO genre assertion on purpose — its audio read is a genuinely ambiguous low-confidence label (Chiptune @ 0.35) and pinning it would make the gate flap; it contributes BPM/key/decode coverage and is the CC0-licensed file of the set.
